title: Plaschke: Sean McVay's travel gamble turns Rams' Australian opener into a jet-lagged flop

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Plaschke: Sean McVay's travel gamble turns Rams' Australian opener into a jet-lagged flop
sources.description: The Rams' decision to leave late for Australia coupled with Sean McVay making a bad play call at a critical moment all add up to a humiliating loss.
